verdict.rationale: The official repo lists "Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions" as a GitHub integration, alongside @gemini-cli mentions in pull requests and non-interactive scripting for workflow automation. A hands-on community report says Gemini code review consistently gave better tips than Copilot and caught real bugs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on setup and on triggering the review automatically on every pull request, and detail on how the feedback is posted (inline suggestions, configuration).
